messages.subject: Re: r/qtl discussion: Inputting a mapping data from another mapping program (JoinMap) in R/qtl
parts:
I don't quite understand why you're trying to determine marker order de novo, when you already have a physical map. I would focus on identifying major problems in the physical map, which would generally be large-scale rearrangements rather than the sort of local marker order problems that ripple() can find.

But for 3 and X, there seems to be essentially no recombination and so you won't be able to determine marker order from the genotype data. There are big blocks of un-recombined markers on chr 2 and 4, as well, which I'd clip out before trying to assess the order of the rest. There are a couple of blocks on markers on chr 3 and X with excessive BB genotypes which looks to me like it's maybe a genotyping problem.

Regarding ripple, I presume you're using method="likelihood" which is quite computational intensive as it tries to re-estimate inter-marker distances with every order considered. I'd recommend using the default method="countxo" would should take seconds rather than hours even with window=7.

karl
